metadata.article_title: Special right of appeal in certain cases

article.title: Special right of appeal in certain cases
article.content: Notwithstanding anything in this Chapter, when more persons than one are convicted in one trial, and an appealable judgment or order has been passed in respect of any of such persons, all or any of the persons convicted at such trial shall have a right of appeal.
article.html:
421Special right of appeal in certain cases

Section 421 · Chapter XXXI

Notwithstanding anything in this Chapter, when more persons than one are convicted in one trial, and an appealable judgment or order has been passed in respect of any of such persons, all or any of the persons convicted at such trial shall have a right of appeal.
